answers.core: Even if this can be done with a simple script, i think that this functionality has to be packed with the engine out of the box. Since the addition of UIDs to the engine, it is expected that they have a more intuitive and better integration with the engine. So this is change for the better of the usability and accessibility of UIDs.
answers.workaround: I think that this can be done with a tool script or a plugin. The engine already has a method to convert file paths to UID:  https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_resourceuid.html#class-resourceuid-method-path-to-uid

title: Add the ability to convert a path to uid in the script editor
